name: Crossbow Expert
summary: +1 Dex; ignore Loading on crossbows, no Disadvantage firing them up close, add modifier to Light crossbow extra attacks.

benefits.name: Ignore Loading
benefits.summary: Ignore the Loading property of crossbows, and load them without a free hand.
benefits.text: You ignore the Loading property of the Hand Crossbow, Heavy Crossbow and Light Crossbow (called crossbows in this feat). While holding one, you can load a piece of ammunition into it even if you lack a free hand.

benefits.name: Firing in Melee
benefits.summary: An enemy within 5 feet doesn't give you Disadvantage on crossbow attack rolls.
benefits.text: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with crossbows.

benefits.name: Dual Wielding
benefits.summary: Add your ability modifier to the Light property's extra attack when it is made with a Light crossbow.
benefits.text: When you make the extra attack granted by the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to its damage if that attack is made with a crossbow that has the Light property and you aren't already adding that modifier to the damage.
